Blue.name: Deadeye Socket Plate
Blue.flavor: Screwed in crooked, aims true anyway.

Blue.name: Scope-Skin Flap
Blue.flavor: Stretched thin so you can squint through it and lie about your aim.

Blue.name: Longshot Gristle Strap
Blue.flavor: Pulls your eye further than your neck wants to go.

Blue.name: Bowstring Tendon Wrap
Blue.flavor: Snaps forward like it's got a grudge.

Blue.name: Jackrabbit Haunch Slab
Blue.flavor: Kicks like it owes the ground money.

Blue.name: Boar-Hide Collar
Blue.flavor: Chokes the bite before it chokes you.

Blue.name: Moth-Wing Camo Patch
Blue.flavor: Blink and you've already lost it.

Blue.name: Puddle-Skin Drape
Blue.flavor: Looks like nothing, smells like less.

Purple.name: Skulking Flank-Flap
Purple.flavor: Stand still and you're just a weird bush. A bush that wants your neck.

Purple.name: Nightcreep Haunch-Hide
Purple.flavor: Blends in so good even it forgets where it's hiding.

Purple.name: Vanish-Tuft Tail-Fluff
Purple.flavor: Poof. Where'd the murderer go? Still right there.

Purple.name: Throat-Snap Jaw-Hinge
Purple.flavor: One twitch and you're already bleeding.

Purple.name: Backstab Spine-Ridge
Purple.flavor: Built for the lunge nobody sees coming.

Purple.name: Ambush Ankle-Spring
Purple.flavor: Coiled like a bad idea waiting to happen.

Purple.name: Eyeshine Brow-Slat
Purple.flavor: Spots the twitch in the grass before the grass knows it twitched.

Purple.name: Long-Stare Ear-Flap
Purple.flavor: Hears your heartbeat from three bushes away.

Purple.name: Gristle Shoulder-Plate
Purple.flavor: Takes the hit meant for something softer. You.

Purple.name: Knuckle Rib-Wrap
Purple.flavor: Wrapped in the loser's hide. Tougher than it looks, uglier too.

Grey.name: Doomsight Nub
Grey.flavor: Squints once. You're already dead, you just haven't heard yet.

Grey.name: Widow's Peak Plate
Grey.flavor: Bolted on backwards so it can watch you run away.

Grey.name: The Long Stare Slab
Grey.flavor: Doesn't blink. Doesn't need to. You'll move first.

Grey.name: Avalanche Haunch
Grey.flavor: Turns walking into an apology you never sent.

Grey.name: Doom-Piston Flank
Grey.flavor: One leg, all business, zero warning.

Grey.name: World-Eater's Hide Patch
Grey.flavor: Chewed on it once. Grew back thicker outta spite.

Grey.name: Iron Tax Collar
Grey.flavor: Pays for every hit twice — once in metal, once in your teeth.

Grey.name: Last-Thing-You-See Pauldron
Grey.flavor: The final image is this plate, then nothing.

Grey.name: Ash-Shroud Flank Wrap
Grey.flavor: Stands in the smoke. Smoke stands back.

Grey.name: Grey-on-Grey Underbelly
Grey.flavor: Blends in by being exactly as boring as the rock.

Red.name: Spring-Shank
Red.flavor: Bolted to the leg that already never stops kicking.

Red.name: Rabbit-Nub
Red.flavor: Rips clean off, grows back meaner, kicks harder every time.

Red.name: Coiled Gristle
Red.flavor: Wound up tight like it owes somebody money.

Red.name: Bug-Eye Flap
Red.flavor: Clocks the flinch before the meal knows it's flinching.

Red.name: Stalk-Wart
Red.flavor: Grows an eyeball someplace an eyeball has no business being.

Red.name: Ear-Flap Twitcher
Red.flavor: Hears the fart a full second before the flinch.

Red.name: Gristle Plate
Red.flavor: Thin as your excuses, tougher than it looks.

Red.name: Knucklebone Knot
Red.flavor: Bites back when something dumb enough bites first.

Red.name: Molt-Rag Tassel
Red.flavor: Flaps like shed skin nobody in their right mind would eat.

Red.name: Dust-Skin Flap
Red.flavor: Looks like dirt, smells like dirt, screams like dinner the second you're caught.

Yellow.name: Knuckle Slab
Yellow.flavor: Bolted-on meat so thick it laughs at teeth.
Yellow.attach: left forelimb, over the shoulder knot

Yellow.name: Broken-Jaw Guard
Yellow.flavor: Ripped off something that hit back. Didn't help it.

Yellow.name: Stomp Rocket
Yellow.flavor: Turns a lumbering waddle into a war crime.

Yellow.name: Gutpunch Piston
Yellow.flavor: Slow to start, rude to arrive.

Yellow.name: Haymaker Hips
Yellow.flavor: Momentum built on spite and gristle.

Yellow.name: Cross-Eyed Glare
Yellow.flavor: One good eye, one bad attitude, both fixed on dinner.

Yellow.name: Bloodhound Nostril Flap
Yellow.flavor: Smells fear from a very rude distance.

Yellow.name: Mudback Hide
Yellow.flavor: Looks like a rock. Hits like a grudge.

Yellow.name: Sulking Lard Coat
Yellow.flavor: Blends into the scenery by being fat and disappointed.
